# RedShelf

> > RedShelf provides digital textbook solutions including eTextbook rentals, an HTML5 cloud reader, and Inclusive Access programs for college students and campus bookstores.

RedShelf offers a comprehensive educational technology platform featuring accessible eTextbooks with Text-to-Speech (TTS), annotation tools, flashcards, and study features. The platform supports students through RedShelf Solve help center with resources for accessibility, Two-Factor Authentication, and citation formats like APA, MLA, and Chicago-Style.

## Key Topics

- RedShelf Solve
- Text to Speech (TTS)
- Inclusive Access
- Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
- Digital textbooks
- Textbook rental
- HTML5 cloud reader
- Accessibility features
- Annotation tools
- Flashcards and study tools
- Campus bookstore integration
- APA, MLA, Chicago-Style citations
- Online learning
- Student collaboration
- Educational technology

## Core Platform

- [RedShelf](https://redshelf.com): RedShelf homepage for eTextbooks, rentals, and HTML5 cloud reader

## Support & Help Center

- [RedShelf Solve](https://solve.redshelf.com): RedShelf Solve help center with TTS accessibility and student support
